title: Unfixed non-public security issues
body:
Hi!

The mission of this ticket is to share and list existence of unfixed non-public security issues with libexpat. Issue #1076 already did some of that, but it's no longer a single issue but multiple. In order of reporting, the current list is this:

- [x] 2025-09-25 Unfixed non-public vulnerability "one" — pull request #1216
- [ ] 2025-09-25 Unfixed non-public vulnerability "two" (i.e. #1076) — validated
- [ ] 2025-11-27 Unfixed non-public vulnerability "three" — validated
- [x] 2026-02-24 Unfixed non-public vulnerability — pull request #1162

- [x] 2026-03-04 Unfixed non-public vulnerability — pull request #1163
- [x] 2026-04-24 Unfixed non-public vulnerability — pull request #1246

- [x] 2026-06-20 Unfixed non-public vulnerability — pull request #1278
- [x] 2026-06-23 Unfixed public vulnerability — pull request #1282
- [x] 2026-07-24 Unfixed non-public vulnerability — pull request #1321
- [x] 2026-07-28 Unfixed non-public vulnerability (date where I got CC'ed) — pull request #1296
- [x] 2026-08-12 Unfixed non-public vulnerability — pull request #1322
- [x] 2026-08-14 Unfixed non-public vulnerability — pull request #1326
- [x] 2026-08-17 Unfixed non-public vulnerability — pull request #1393
- [x] 2026-08-17 Unfixed non-public vulnerability — CVE-2026-77215 reserved, rejected, [works as documented](https://libexpat.github.io/doc/api/latest/#XML_StopParser)
- [x] 2026-08-17 Unfixed non-public vulnerability — CVE-2026-77216 reserved, rejected, not considered a vulnerability
- [ ] 2026-08-18 Unfixed non-public vulnerability — TBA, yet to be validated
- [x] 2026-09-11 Unfixed non-public vulnerability — not a vulnerability, [works as documented](https://libexpat.github.io/doc/api/latest/#XML_StopParser)

Please reach out if:

- **you want to help finding true fixes to these** and
- you are okay with signing a freeform NDA (to keep the vulnerability details confidential until a true fix has made its way into Git `master`).

Best, Sebastian

PS: Comments are intentionally closed, please reach out via the e-mail in my profile, instead.
